item.title: Charlotte Douglas Prepares for 1.68M Travelers During Spring Break Period
item.description: Charlotte Douglas International Airport expects over 1.68 million passengers between April 2 and April 12. Officials predict more than 7,900 flights will leave during this 11-day window.
